U.note: Classic night cottage globe on a wooden plinth with clean snow and a shake that settles, a bit flat but very readable and tidy on phone.

V.note: Charming shelf vignette with candle, books and plant and a tilting shake, but the globe is small, the control panel covers the scene, and snow reads faint.

W.note: Beautiful glass and lighthouse with glitter, but the dome has no base so it reads as a glass ball on a table, and the wide panel crowds the layout.

X.note: Best glass, depth and layered scene with gold rim and wooden base, glitter churns and settles convincingly, though the side panel is busy.

Y.note: Polished cabin globe with a gold collar, dense snow and a nice tilt on shake, controls sit tidily below and work on phone.

Z.note: Inventive fisheye rooftop city with a dark base, but the snow reads as confetti and the scene is murky and less obviously a snow globe.
